name: smwgraphics-modern-redrawn-styled-fishbone
title: Modern Redrawn Styled Fishbone
description:
Redrawn-styled modern Fishbone graphics based off of Super Mario Maker's and NSMBU's Fishbone graphics. Meant to be used with other SMW Redrawn and its appropriately styled graphic assets instead of default SMW's graphic assets.

Comes in 3 different heads, all ready to be inserted into GFX03. Please read the .txt for further instructions on the specific differences of the heads and palette information.
